name: Docusign
summary: Electronic signature and agreement management. Its first-party MCP server, in open beta, exposes 24 tools (22 over envelopes, recipients, templates, users and Maestro workflows, plus two read-only "skill" tools that instruct the calling model): create an envelope, set signers and their routing order, read envelope and recipient status, remind pending signers, and void. The tool catalog is published without credentials at mcp.docusign.com/tools; the endpoint itself answered 403 to a probe with no token, and the vendor accepts only Confidential Authorization Code Grant tokens.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-27 18:11Z, no credentials: POST mcp.docusign.com/mcp answers 403 "RBAC: access denied", no www-authenticate; the root well-known URI serves the OAuth resource document, six scopes (three on 09-18); GET /tools serves 24 tools (22 on 09-18). Confidential Auth Code Grant only.

jobs.summary: The vendor's published MCP tool catalog, read without credentials: createEnvelope from a template or remote document, updateEnvelopeRecipients with a routingOrder per signer, getEnvelope and listRecipients for status, sendReminder to pending signers, updateEnvelope to send or void. Not executed.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-18, re-read 2026-09-27, unchanged: plans are bought on the vendor's checkout (Personal $11/month, Standard $30/user/month, Business Pro $45/user/month, annual commitments); the page names no payment method for the subscription. The MCP server has no price and speaks no 402 protocol.
